items.title: Benefits and Challenges of AI in Society (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Benefits and Challenges of AI in Society (PDF 108-109, printed 104-105).

blocks.text: AI jadeed zindagi mein efficiency (kam waqt mein zyada kaam), durusti aur sahulat barha kar bare fawaid lati hai. Yeh takrari (repetitive) kaam insanon se tez karti hai, doctors ki beemari pehchanne (diagnosis) mein madad karti hai, aur kisanon ko faslon ki behtar nigrani mein madad deti hai. Maslan DeepMind ki AI aankh ke 3D scans analyze kar ke glaucoma jaisi aankh ki beemariyon ka andaza un ke wazeh alamat aane se pehle laga sakti hai. Karobar mein Amazon aur Daraz jaisi companies AI chatbots se hazaron users ke sawalon, jaise “Mera order kahan hai?”, ka ek hi waqt mein jawab deti hain. Karobar AI se gahakon ka rawaiya analyze karte, trends ka andaza lagate aur behtar faisle karte hain. Taleem mein AI personalized learning aur adaptive tutoring (har talib ke mutabiq parhai) mein madad deti hai.

In fawaid ke bawajood AI kuch challenges bhi lati hai jinhein ehtiyat se sambhalna zaroori hai. In mein data privacy (raazdari), naukriyon ka khatma (job displacement), aur algorithms ka bias shamil hai jo na-insafi wale nataij de sakta hai (Figure 8.2). Jab AI systems logon ki zindagi par asar dalne wale faisle karte hain to akhlaqi masle bhi uthte hain. Nayi ijaad aur zimmedari mein tawazun rakhne se AI insaniyat ke liye faidemand rehti hai, nuqsan deh nahi. In challenges ko samajhne se har shobe mein AI ka munsifana, shaffaf aur akhlaqi istemal barhta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Kisan drones aur sensors ke saath AI use kar ke faslon ki nigrani karte hain, jis se paidawar barhti aur zaya kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: AI ke do fawaid aur do challenges likhein, aur batayein ke tawazun (balance) kyun zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation: Fawaid: maslan diagnosis mein madad (DeepMind aankh ke scan se glaucoma ka pehle andaza) aur chatbots ka hazaron users ko aik saath jawab. Challenges: data privacy, job displacement, algorithm ka bias. Nayi ijaad aur zimmedari ka tawazun AI ko insaniyat ke liye faidemand rakhta hai, nuqsan deh nahi.

items: Fawaid: efficiency, accuracy, sahulat; sehat, karobar, zaraat aur taleem mein madad.
Challenges: privacy, naukriyan, bias aur akhlaqi faisle; Figure 8.2 vision, speech aur decision-making dikhati hai.
